fields.FIR_Description: The reported incident took place on 2025-10-27 (night, 23:15): A yellow scooter bearing registration number TN-68-YY-1088 of the complainant was reported missing from Tamarai Garden Parking Area. The complainant, Gopal Karuppasamy, provided the contact number 9000000390. Vignesh Subramani (mobile 9000000487) was named as a possible person of interest. The complaint refers to Kishore Babu, a driver, reachable on 9000000076. Records suggest a possible link with FIR-2026-00023, as the mobile number 9000000487 is associated with a suspect in both entries.
fields.Modus_Operandi: Scooter reportedly taken from an unattended parking area.
